title: Prediksi Rezim Pasar Model Markov #2
last_msg:
**Nggak bisa (atau minimal belum didukung secara *native*).**

Gue baru aja ngecek database lu, dan bener kata lu, provider `antigravity`, `codex`, (dan `claude` yang lu sebutin tadi) itu jalan pake **OAuth (Login via Browser / Token Exchange)**, bukan statik API Key. 

Ini alasan teknis kenapa **Cloudflare AI Gateway gak mempan (gak jalan)** buat model OAuth kayak gini:

### 1. Cloudflare Cuma Ngenalin "Static Bearer Token"
Cloudflare AI Gateway itu bodoh di urusan otentikasi. Dia cuma dirancang buat nangkep *Header* `Authorization: Bearer *** lalu nerusin *request* itu ke URL standar provider. 
Kalau 9Router lu pake OAuth, aliran koneksinya beda jauh (ada proses minta token, *refresh token*, dan verifikasi sesi).

### 2. URL Endpoint Beda (Hardcoded)
Provider kayak *Codex* atau *Antigravity (Gemini)* yang *internal/enterprise* biasanya punya URL otentikasi dan eksekusi yang *hardcoded* di dalam kode aplikasinya (SDK) atau *plugin* 9Router-nya, bukan sekadar nerima lemparan Base URL biasa.

Cloudflare AI Gateway cuma ngerti rute `/openai`, `/anthropic`, `/huggingface`, dll. Kalau *Antigravity* punya rute `/v1/oauth2/token` atau beda bentuk, Cloudflare bakal nolak *request*-nya (Error 404).

---

### Terus Gimana Cara Nyembunyiin IP VPS Lu?

Kalo lu pake OAuth, lupakan Cloudflare AI Gateway. Lu **wajib** main di level OS/Network. Lu harus pake **WARP-CLI**.

Gue jelasin tadi kan, kalo pake WARP, IP VPS lu dibungkus dari bawah (jaringan servernya). Jadi pas 9Router ngelakuin proses *OAuth login* atau nge-hit API Codex/Antigravity, paket datanya udah keluar dari Cloudflare, bukan dari Tencent.

Kelemahan WARP: Gak ada *caching* & metrik ala AI Gateway. Kelebihannya: Semua trafik (termasuk OAuth, *git push*, *curl*) 100% aman dan sembunyi.

Kalo lu mau **WARP-CLI**, gue bisa bantuin pasang sekarang. Tapi ini mainan di level *network (routing)*, jadi gue bakal ekstra hati-hati biar SSH VPS lu nggak ikut putus. Mau di-gas WARP aja?

## Inti
**Top 3 Hermes integrations:**
1. **Obsidian**

2. **Reddit**

3. **InsForge**  
   Agent-native backend layer: auth, DB, storage, edge functions.

|---|---|---|
| Obsidian | ✅ sudah core stack | Keep. Ini sudah jadi second brain lu. |

Loop murah:
- input: niche/problem

{"output": "# Animated AI Sites - Money Play. Playbook: From First Render to First Wire.

Sites that cost $5,000–$10,000 from agencies five years ago now ship for under $15 in tokens. Buyer-side pricing has not moved. That gap is the trade. Below - every prompt copy-pasteable, every cost line verifiable on a public pricing page, every shortcut earned by operators who already burned the credits.
 
Anonymous dev posted a 3D scroll-driven product site on X last month. No name. No portfolio. Built in a weekend with Gemini. Mr. Doob - creator of Three.js - noticed. Five paid projects in his DMs. One job offer. Zero followers required. The work spoke. The system below is the same one he ran, rebuilt from four open tutorials and cross-checked against current tool pricing.

02. The old barrier was real
Five years ago a site with custom 3D scroll, audio synthesis, and procedural shaders required a team - frontend dev in Three.js docs, 3D artist on Spline, motion designer on GSAP, backend hand on the pipeline. Six weeks. $5,000 floor. $10,000 ceiling. Most freelancers could not quote it, so they did not.
You needed shader math, scroll-sequence locomotion, custom React hooks recalculating 3D dimensions per viewport, Spline exports with masked transparent backgrounds, video loops under 2 MB, Vercel deploys that did not break on launch night. Every one of those barriers is gone. Not easier. Gone.
What replaced them is a four-stage pipeline that runs on ~$55 a month and a single master prompt. Nano Banana Pro generates the still. Cling 3.0 or Seed Dance 2.0 animates it. Claude Design drafts the layout. Claude Code finishes the integration. Netlify hosts it free. Animated heroes deliver a measurable conversion lift - operators on X cite a 1.5-3x range, depending on niche and traffic source. Anecdotal, not a controlled study. Treat as directional until your own analytics confirm it on your store.

 
03. Behind the build - the unlock moment
One clip, phone-recorded, no editing. The master prompt drops, Claude Code starts shipping integration code in real time. This is the moment that used to take a senior frontend dev a full week - captured in 28 seconds on a Friday afternoon.

 
STAGE 3 · MASTER PROMPT AT WORK
Code shipping in real time
What you see: master prompt template paste · Claude Code streams integration
Time captured: 28 seconds of a 4-hour build
The unlock: locked design system → JSX writes itself
Next move: surgical iteration until Lighthouse holds at 90+

The rest of the workflow sits around this clip - reference hunt before, mobile breakpoint after, Netlify deploy at the end. This 28-second window is where the AI math actually flips. Five years ago this took a senior frontend dev a week. Now it is one prompt and a coffee.

04. Real numbers - cost stack per build
Line items at current Higgsfield + Claude + Netlify pricing. Verify each row on the tool's public pricing page before you quote a client - credit costs change every quarter.
 
Quote a build at the freelance floor of $1,500-3,000 and the multiple is still 150-400x against tokens. Top-of-market work with custom shaders and scroll-heavy 3D goes for $3-5K on Fiverr Pro and Upwork - public listings you can verify in 30 seconds. The arbitrage holds until competition drives down rates. That is the window this article is about.

05. Part 1  Pick the niche
Four niches naturally fit this format. Ranked by client budget × close-rate signal across freelance marketplaces and X operator threads:
3D product e-commerce - sneakers, headphones, watches, supplements. Highest signal. Paid-ad founders already understand that hero motion lifts checkout rate.
SaaS hero with cinematic background - AI tools, fintech, dev platforms. Mid signal. Decision cycles longer because of analytics scrutiny.
Architecture / interior portfolio - exploding-view scroll sequences. Mid signal. Smaller average ticket but lower competition.
Crypto / on-chain dashboards - rotating space station, particle fields. Low close-rate signal but the highest viral coefficient on X for portfolio reach.
E-commerce wins on conversion sensitivity. Founders running paid ads understand cost-per-acquisition - show them a hover effect on a product image and the math writes itself. Pick one, lock for 90 days. The master prompt compounds when the niche is fixed.

// niche_validator.prompt
 
06 .Part 2 - The pipeline · Stage 1: Reference & composition
The most expensive mistake at this stage is generating the hero before deciding where the text goes. Composition fights the layout, you regenerate, four credits become twelve. Draw a paper thumbnail with a Sharpie first. Every time.
Open three tabs. Dribbble - search "landing page SaaS," save five layouts. Spline community at spline. design/community - remix a free 3D scene, never start from scratch when 40,000 free assets are already there. Awwwards - steal the spacing rhythm from sites that already won. Then decide where the dead space lives, where the headline floats, where the CTA lands. Lock all three before you generate a single asset. This step saves more credits than any prompt trick in the article.
 
// reference_extractor.prompt
 
07. Stage 2: Generate the assets
Two assets per build. A still for mobile fallback. A 5-15 second video for desktop hero. The fallback is non-negotiable - a 4 MB hero video on a phone tanks Lighthouse, drops the SEO ranking, and triggers a refund request in week two. Build with the mobile cut in mind from prompt one.

// nano_banana_still.prompt
 
// cling_3_video.prompt
 
Two rules from operators who burned through 10+ generation runs. Never enable "enhance prompt" - the model invents a music video and you lose control. Lock the center of mass directly in the prompt. The single line "rotating in the exact same place, center of mass does not move" fixes 80% of drift problems on day one.

08. Stage 3: The master prompt
This is where most builds break. Pasting a screenshot with "build this" produces output that looks like every other AI landing page on X. The master prompt is the difference.
A master prompt is a locked document. Establishes authority. Locks the reference as source of truth. Extracts the design system. Sets breakpoint rules. Forces a Q&A round before any code ships. Keep yours in a Raycast snippet - you will paste the skeleton into every chat.

// master_prompt.template
 
The last line is the unlock. Plan mode catches 80% of design ambiguity before any JSX ships. The Q&A round takes 90 seconds and saves three hours downstream.

09. Stage 4: Surgical iteration + ship
First pass is never final. Writing "this layout feels off" costs two hours fixing the wrong thing. Write the exact fix with the exact number. The shift to scoped numerical feedback is the second biggest unlock after the master prompt.

// surgical_iteration.prompt
 
The "do not change anything else" line on every prompt. Without it the model gets helpful, refactors a working component, breaks the hero. That single line saves an hour per build.

// video_integration.prompt
 
When the hero MP4 plays choppy, one prompt fixes it: "extract video frames as optimized JPEGs and preload them on scroll." Documented result on a real build: 6 MB → 250 KB, sub-2-second load. Push to GitHub. Connect Netlify. SSL provisions in 15 minutes. Site is live.

Three build paths work right now. Rotate between them based on the client and the brief - each one is documented across the four source tutorials this article is built on.

Five years ago an animated 3D landing page meant a team and a $5,000-$10,000 invoice. AI closed the gap. Pricing on the buyer side has not moved because the market does not know yet. That window is the trade.

Pixel Agents turns multi-agent AI systems into something you can actually see and manage. Each agent becomes a character in a pixel art office. They walk around, sit at their desk, and visually reflect what they are doing — typing when writing code, reading when searching files, waiting when it needs your attention. It ships in **two flavors from the same source tree**: - **VS Code extension** — `pablodelucca.pixel-agents` on the [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pablodelucca.pixel-agents) and [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/pablodelucca/pixel-agents). Useful in tmux workflows, remote sessions, or any environment without a desktop VS Code. Internally, the architecture is fully agent-agnostic and platform-agnostic: a typed `HookProvider` interface defines the integration boundary so adding a new AI tool is a single subdirectory of code. Claude Code is the reference implementation today; Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and others are on the roadmap. ![Pixel Agents screenshot](webview-ui/public/Screenshot.jpg) ## Features - **One agent, one character** — every Claude Code terminal gets its own animated character - **Live activity tracking** — characters animate based on what the agent is actually doing (writing, reading, running commands) - **Office layout editor** — design your office with floors, walls, and furniture using a built-in editor - **Speech bubbles** — visual indicators when an agent is waiting for input or needs permission - **Sound notifications** — optional chime when an agent finishes its turn - **Sub-agent visualization** — Task tool sub-agents spawn as separate characters linked to their parent - **Persistent layouts** — your office design is saved and shared across VS Code windows - **External asset directories** — load custom or third-party furniture packs from any folder on your machine - **Diverse characters** — 6 diverse characters. These are based on the amazing work of [JIK-A-4, Metro City](https://jik-a-4.itch.io/metrocity-free-topdown-character-pack).

# 9ROUTER ADD MASS ACCOUNT ANTIGRAVITY PROVIDER

Bot Puppeteer untuk menambahkan akun Google secara bulk ke Antigravity Provider pada tools 9Router.

## Fitur

- Login otomatis ke multiple akun Google
- Otomatis membaca daftar akun dari file `akun.txt`
- Akun yang berhasil ditambahkan otomatis dihapus dari list
- Looping otomatis sampai semua akun selesai
- Delay antar akun untuk menghindari rate limit

## Requirements

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) v18 atau lebih baru
- [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) terinstall di sistem
- npm (sudah termasuk saat install Node.js)

### Dependencies

| Package | Versi | Keterangan |
|---------|-------|------------|
| [puppeteer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/puppeteer) | ^24.43.1 | Browser automation (otomatis download Chromium saat install) |

## Instalasi

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/defryarhinsa/Add-Mass-Account-AntiGravity-to-9Router.git
cd Add-Mass-Account-AntiGravity-to-9Router

# Install dependencies
npm install
```

> `npm install` akan otomatis menginstall **puppeteer** beserta **Chromium browser** yang dibutuhkan. Proses ini memerlukan koneksi internet dan mungkin memakan waktu beberapa menit.

### Buat File Akun

Buat file `akun.txt` di root folder, isi dengan daftar akun format `email|password` (satu akun per baris):

```
akun1@gmail.com|password123
akun2@gmail.com|password456
akun3@gmail.com|password789
```

## Konfigurasi

### 1. Disable Require Login pada 9ROUTER

> **PENTING:** Langkah ini wajib dilakukan sebelum menjalankan bot, jika tidak bot tidak akan bisa berjalan.

1. Buka halaman **9ROUTER** di browser
2. Masuk ke menu **Setting**
3. Cari opsi **Require Login**
4. **Matikan / Disable** opsi tersebut
5. Simpan perubahan

### 2. Sesuaikan Target URL

Pastikan target URL di `bot.js` sudah sesuai (default: `http://localhost:20128/`).

## Penggunaan

```bash
node bot.js
```

## Alur Bot

1. Buka browser dan navigasi ke target URL
2. Klik **Provider** > **Antigravity**
3. Untuk setiap akun di `akun.txt`:
   - Klik **Add** > **I Understand, Continue**
   - Tab baru terbuka (Google Login)
   - Isi email > klik **Next**
   - Isi password > klik **Next**
   - Klik **I Understand**
   - Klik **Login**
   - Akun berhasil > dihapus dari `akun.txt`
   - Browser ditutup, delay 3 detik
   - Buka browser baru untuk akun berikutnya
4. Selesai jika semua akun sudah ditambahkan

## Struktur File

```
autologin/
+-- bot.js          # Script utama bot
+-- akun.txt        # Daftar akun (tidak di-upload ke GitHub)
+-- package.json    # Dependencies project
+-- .gitignore      # File yang di-ignore oleh Git
+-- README.md       # Dokumentasi
```

## Catatan

- Bot berjalan dalam mode **visible** (bukan headless) karena Google login memblokir akses headless.
- Jika bot dihentikan di tengah proses, akun yang belum diproses tetap tersimpan di `akun.txt`. Cukup jalankan ulang `node bot.js` untuk melanjutkan.
- Pastikan koneksi internet stabil saat menjalankan bot.
- File `akun.txt` tidak di-upload ke GitHub demi keamanan. Buat manual setelah clone.

## Disclaimer

Bot ini dibuat untuk keperluan pribadi. Gunakan dengan bijak dan sesuai ketentuan layanan yang berlaku.

"Second Brain" / Command Center untuk mengelola 36+ project via Obsidian, synced via GitHub Actions.

## Tech Stack

- **Tool:** Obsidian (Markdown/Knowledge Base)
- **Sync:** GitHub Actions (daily at 06:00 UTC)
- **Plugins:** Dataview (for project dashboards)

## Key Features

- Project Health Dashboard (Dataview tables)
- "Needs Attention" view untuk active high-priority projects
- Scaffolding tracker untuk new projects
- Quick navigation via linked maps (Projects, Decisions, Weekly Reviews)
- Domain-based organization (Nazhir & Wakaf, Marketing Digital, Tech Stack)

## Folder Structure

```
obsidian/
├── 00-INBOX/       # Temporary notes and captures
├── 01-PROJECTS/    # Active project notes
├── 02-AREAS/       # Ongoing responsibilities
├── 03-RESOURCES/   # Reference materials
├── 04-ARCHIVE/     # Completed/inactive items
├── 05-TEMPLATES/   # Note templates
└── 99-META/        # Meta notes and system documentation
```

## Key Conventions

- PARA method (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive)
- Daily notes untuk tracking
- Dataview queries untuk dashboard automation
- GitHub Actions untuk cross-device sync
- Linked references untuk bidirectional connections
- **AI Memory Sync** — Hermes Agent auto-writes memory ke `03-RESOURCES/ai-memory/`

Hermes + Obsidian: a second brain for your agent
      kepo
                                                                                  Ikuti

  9                  9                    50             15 rb



Every agent I've tried has goldfish brain. Half the session is spent re-
explaining the project before I can even ask the actual question. Cool, very
productive

Hermes Agent v0.14 fixes this by reading and writing straight into an Obsidian vault.
The vault is now the memory.
                    Keluar            3

That's the whole pitch. Below is the setup and what it actually does once it's running.


1. The vault IS the memory
 No vector DB. No embeddings. No hidden context layer you can't inspect. Hermes
treats your Obsidian folder as plain .md files. It reads them at the start of a session,
writes back at the end, and the next session picks up exactly where the last one left
off


You can open any of these files yourself and edit them. There is no black box to crack.
It's just markdown, and the markdown is yours.


This is the part that took me a second to internalize. Most "memory" features in
agents are opaque on purpose. Hermes is the opposite. You can literally watch the
thing think on disk.


2. Install (3 minutes, no cap)


# Step 1 - Install Hermes
  python

 curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash




# Step 2 - Create vault folder


 python

 mkdir -p ~/Documents/Obsidian/Hermes-Agent/{Projects,Research,Daily,Memory-Review}




# Step 3 - Wire Obsidian to Hermes


 python

 hermes config set memory.obsidian.vault_path "$HOME/Documents/Obsidian/Hermes-Agent"




# Step 4 - Test it


 python

 hermes chat -q "Read the files in ~/Documents/Obsidian/Hermes-Agent and create PROJECT-RE




The folder structure does work for you:


•   Projects: one note per active project

•   Research: scraped pages, sources, references

•   Daily: timestamped run summaries

•   Memory-Review: candidate facts the agent wants to commit but hasn't yet


Memory-Review is the part I didn't expect to ship for. Every "fact" Hermes wants to
permanently remember about you lands there first. You read it, accept or delete, and
then it migrates to long-term memory. The agent never silently rewrites what it thinks
it knows about you. Massively based design choice
 3. Config


Two lines and you're live:


 python

 hermes config set memory.memory_enabled true
 hermes config set memory.user_profile_enabled true




The second one tells Hermes to maintain a profile of you specifically


What you work on, how you write, what you've already decided about your own
projects. That profile is a .md file too, so when Hermes inevitably gets something
wrong about you, you open it and fix it. Same shape as fixing a typo


4. What you actually get


Auto-maintained project files. You yap at Hermes about a project and the README,
decisions log, and next-actions list update themselves. You can still rewrite them by
hand whenever. They're just notes


A research agent that puts the evidence somewhere real. When you ask Hermes to
research something, the scraped content lands in Research/ with source links, not in
a chat window that vanishes the moment you close the tab. You can come back a
month later and the receipts are still there


Daily briefings. One command in the morning tells you what changed across your
projects since yesterday and what's waiting on you. Morning standup is now zero
humans


Graph view, for free. Hermes drops [[wikilinks]] between related notes while it works.
Obsidian renders the graph. Watching your agent's actual cross-references between
projects is wildly different from just trusting it.
 5. The actual morning command




 python

 hermes chat -q "Read my Daily/ and Projects/, summarize open tasks and priorities for tod




And the evening one:


 python

 hermes chat -q "Summarize today's changes across Projects/ and save to Daily/"




6. "But isn't this just Claude Projects?"
 Claude Projects is read-only context you upload. The agent reads what you put there.
You're the one keeping it current


Hermes reads AND writes. The vault evolves while you work. You stop maintaining
context for the model, the model starts maintaining its own context. That's the entire
shift


7. Safety, but the actual kind


Start with a scoped folder, not your whole vault. Run the read/write loop for a few
days, eyeball what the agent is writing, then expand the path once you trust it.
Trusting an agent with your entire knowledge base on day one is ngmi behavior


Secrets stay in .env, never in markdown. Hermes does not read .env. Put keys there.
Never paste them into notes


Plain .md plays well with git. iCloud, Google Drive, Syncthing all sync it without
complaint. Configure on your server, see the result on your MacBook a few seconds
later. No proprietary format to escape from if you decide this tool isn't for you
 Obsidian's Local REST API is what makes the live read/write work during agent
execution. Skip it and Hermes still works, but updates only show up after you reload
the vault. Install the plugin


8. What's under the hood




Three layers under memory.


A 2,200-character durable memory file that survives restarts. The persistent identity
 layer.


SQLite + FTS5 for full-text search across every past conversation. So "what did I tell
you about the auth flow last month" returns the actual answer, not vibes.


Skills: reusable procedures the agent learns and refines over time. Less prompt-
engineering, more "the agent already knows how to do this from last week."


Obsidian sits on top as the human-readable view of all three.


Beyond memory: 22 messaging platforms, 400+ models, 68 built-in tools, MIT
license, 100K+ GitHub stars. Runs on your laptop, a VPS, or managed cloud. I run it
on a Linux box and pipe everything back to my Mac.


9. Bonus: chain it with NotebookLM




Once your vault is filling up with structured .md, you can point NotebookLM at the
same folder.
 Hermes writes. NotebookLM reads.


You get audio podcast walkthroughs of your week's notes and cross-document Q&A
across every project at once. Same source of truth, two completely different output
modes. Your vault becomes a dataset any AI tool can consume.


This is the part where you realize the vault is the product, and every tool around it is
just a different surface for it.


10. Cost


Hermes itself is MIT and runs on your machine for $0. Daily runtime depends on
which model you wire it to. Haiku for routine work plus Sonnet for the heavy lifts lands
around $0.50 to $2 a day for a solo dev. Local models take it to zero. There is no
"Hermes Pro" subscription quietly funneling you anywhere


Why this matters?




I spent way too long pasting the same context into every prompt. Project summary,
 recent decisions, current blockers, then the actual question. Four-paragraph prompts
just to get a usable answer.


That entire ritual was just memory I was carrying for the model


Move it into a vault and your prompts get short again. You stop being the model's
RAM. You start working alongside it instead of briefing it from scratch every session


The leverage is gigabrain

Quick reference for connecting a Hermes profile to Discord as a bot.

## 1. Create Discord Application

1. Go to https://discord.com/developers/applications
2. Click **"New Application"** (NOT "Bot" — Bot menu appears after creation)
3. Name it (e.g. `SAIF`)
4. Click **Create**

## 2. Get Bot Token

1. In sidebar, click **"Bot"** (under General Information)
2. Under **Build-A-Bot**, click **"Reset Token"** or **"Copy"**
3. Save token securely — never share it

## 3. Enable Privileged Gateway Intents

| Intent | Required | Why |
|--------|----------|-----|
| **MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT** | ✅ **WAJIB** | Bot can read message content |
| PRESENCE INTENT | Optional | Detect user status |
| SERVER MEMBERS INTENT | Optional | Access member list |

Without MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT, bot will be silent.

## 4. Invite Bot to Server

1. Click **OAuth2** → **URL Generator** in sidebar
2. Scopes: centang **bot**
3. Bot Permissions: minimal — **Send Messages**, **Read Message History**
4. Copy generated URL, paste in browser
5. Select server → Authorize

## 5. Configure Hermes Profile

```bash
# Set bot token (NEVER paste in chat — use terminal only)
hermes -p <profile> config set gateway.discord.bot_token "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"

# Set Application ID (from General Information page)
hermes -p <profile> config set gateway.discord.application_id "YOUR_APP_ID"

# Enable Discord gateway
hermes -p <profile> config set gateway.discord.enabled true

# Set home channel (optional — bot will auto-respond in any channel)
hermes -p <profile> config set gateway.discord.home_channel_id "CHANNEL_ID"
```

## 6. Create Profile Wrapper Command (Optional)

The `hermes profile create` command creates a wrapper script, but it may not be in PATH. Create it manually:

```bash
# Create wrapper command
echo '#!/bin/sh
exec hermes -p <profile> "$@"' > ~/.local/bin/<profile>
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/<profile>

# Verify
which <profile>
```

## 7. Start Gateway

```bash
# Foreground (for testing — shows logs in real-time)
hermes -p <profile> gateway run

# Background service (requires interactive confirmation)
hermes -p <profile> gateway install
# When prompted: Y to start now, n for systemd auto-start

# Alternative: background with nohup
nohup hermes -p <profile> gateway run > /tmp/<profile>-gateway.log 2>&1 &
tail -f /tmp/<profile>-gateway.log
```

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---------|-------|-----|
| Bot silent | MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT disabled | Enable in Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents |
| Bot not responding | Wrong token or not invited | Re-copy token, re-generate invite URL |
| Gateway crash | Config missing required fields | Check `gateway.discord.*` keys in config.yaml |
| "No models provided" error | UTF-8 BOM in config.yaml | Re-save config as UTF-8 without BOM |
| `saif` command not found | Wrapper not in PATH | Create manually: `echo '#!/bin/sh\nexec hermes -p saif "$@"' > ~/.local/bin/saif && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/saif` |
| Gateway install hangs | Interactive prompt waiting | Use PTY mode or run in real terminal |
| `hermes gateway install` fails | Service not installed | Try `hermes -p <profile> gateway run` first to test |

### Important: Token Security

- **Never paste Discord Bot Token in chat** (Telegram, Discord, etc.) — tokens are persistent in session history
- **Never commit token to Git** — add `.env` and config files with tokens to `.gitignore`
- **Set token via terminal only**: `hermes -p <profile> config set gateway.discord.bot_token "TOKEN"`
- **Clear shell history after setting**: `history -c && history -w`
- **Regenerate token** if accidentally exposed: Discord Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token

## Config Keys Reference

```yaml
gateway:
  discord:
    enabled: true
    bot_token: ''           # Required — Bot Token from Discord portal
    application_id: ''       # Optional — from General Information
    public_key: ''           # Optional — for interactions endpoint
    guild_id: ''             # Optional — restrict to specific server
    channel_id: ''           # Optional — restrict to specific channel
    admin_role_id: ''        # Optional — role for admin commands
    home_channel_id: ''      # Optional — default channel for responses
```

---README---
# 🧬 Hermes Agent Self-Evolution

**Evolutionary self-improvement for [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent).**

Hermes Agent Self-Evolution uses DSPy + GEPA (Genetic-Pareto Prompt Evolution) to automatically evolve and optimize Hermes Agent's skills, tool descriptions, system prompts, and code — producing measurably better versions through reflective evolutionary search.

**No GPU training required.** Everything operates via API calls — mutating text, evaluating results, and selecting the best variants. ~$2-10 per optimization run.

## How It Works

```
Read current skill/prompt/tool ──► Generate eval dataset
                                        │
                                        ▼
                                   GEPA Optimizer ◄── Execution traces
                                        │                    ▲
                                        ▼                    │
                                   Candidate variants ──► Evaluate
                                        │
                                   Constraint gates (tests, size limits, benchmarks)
                                        │
                                        ▼
                                   Best variant ──► PR against hermes-agent
```

GEPA reads execution traces to understand *why* things fail (not just that they failed), then proposes targeted improvements. ICLR 2026 Oral, MIT licensed.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install
git clone https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution.git
cd hermes-agent-self-evolution
pip install -e ".[dev]"

# Point at your hermes-agent repo
export HERMES_AGENT_REPO=~/.hermes/hermes-agent

# Evolve a skill (synthetic eval data)
python -m evolution.skills.evolve_skill \
    --skill github-code-review \
    --iterations 10 \
    --eval-source synthetic

# Or use real session history from Claude Code, Copilot, and Hermes
python -m evolution.skills.evolve_skill \
    --skill github-code-review \
    --iterations 10 \
    --eval-source sessiondb
```

## What It Optimizes

| Phase | Target | Engine | Status |
|-------|--------|--------|--------|
| **Phase 1** | Skill files (SKILL.md) | DSPy + GEPA | ✅ Implemented |
| **Phase 2** | Tool descriptions | DSPy + GEPA | 🔲 Planned |
| **Phase 3** | System prompt sections | DSPy + GEPA | 🔲 Planned |
| **Phase 4** | Tool implementation code | Darwinian Evolver | 🔲 Planned |
| **Phase 5** | Continuous improvement loop | Automated pipeline | 🔲 Planned |

## Engines

| Engine | What It Does | License |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| **[DSPy](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy) + [GEPA](https://github.com/gepa-ai/gepa)** | Reflective prompt evolution — reads execution traces, proposes targeted mutations | MIT |
| **[Darwinian Evolver](https://github.com/imbue-ai/darwinian_evolver)** | Code evolution with Git-based organisms | AGPL v3 (external CLI only) |

## Guardrails

Every evolved variant must pass:
1. **Full test suite** — `pytest tests/ -q` must pass 100%
2. **Size limits** — Skills ≤15KB, tool descriptions ≤500 chars
3. **Caching compatibility** — No mid-conversation changes
4. **Semantic preservation** — Must not drift from original purpose
5. **PR review** — All changes go through human review, never direct commit

## Full Plan

See [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) for the complete architecture, evaluation data strategy, constraints, benchmarks integration, and phased timeline.

Ah, wajar. Hermes di mesin lo disetup pakai **Gateway Service**, namanya `hermes-gateway` (untuk default/raidxelon) dan `hermes-gateway-<profile>.service` (untuk profile lain). Sebagian jalan di system root, sebagian di user level.

### Cara restart yang bener:

Jalankan 3 command ini berturut-turut di SSH lo:

```bash
# Restart gateway utama (raidxelon/default)
sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway
sudo systemctl restart hermes-gateway-raidxelon

# Restart gateway sub-profile (ani, fwp, prodig, saif)
systemctl --user restart hermes-gateway-{ani,fwp,prodig,saif}
```

Pastikan isi `~/.hermes/.env` lo udah bener (cukup `KEY=value`, tanpa petik). 
Setelah restart, semua agen (gw, saif, fwp, prodig) bakal otomatis "melek" sama token GitHub & Cloudflare.

Coba eksekusi, terus konfirmasi ke gue.

**hermes-example-plugins**
Fungsi: Repo referensi/contoh kode plugin developer.
Kerja: Copy folder ke `~/.hermes/plugins/` → `hermes plugins enable [nama]` / restart UI.
Isi:
- `plugin-llm-example`: Calls LLM sinkron (JSON schema).
- `plugin-llm-async-example`: Calls LLM async/konkuren.
- `example-dashboard`: Injeksi tab/API route dashboard.
- `strike-freedom-cockpit`: Reskin UI (tema, layout, aset).

**hermes-paperclip-adapter**
- **Fokus:** Adapter JS/TS untuk menjalankan Hermes Agent sebagai "karyawan" di ekosistem Paperclip.
- **Tujuan:** Menjembatani Hermes Agent dengan Paperclip UI. Mengurai output Hermes (teks/tabel) jadi UI terstruktur, sinkronisasi *skills*, dan manajemen sesi.

**Hermes-Function-Calling**
- **Fokus:** Implementasi Python untuk fitur *function calling* dan JSON *mode* pada model Hermes Pro LLM.
- **Tujuan:** Skrip referensi/inferensi CLI (`functioncall.py`, `jsonmode.py`) untuk memicu model mengeksekusi fungsi eksternal berdasar skema (contoh bawaan: yfinance/saham).

Riset selesai.

**1. hermes-agent**
- **Fungsi Utama**: AI agent *self-improving* (memiliki siklus belajar).
- **Fitur Kunci**:
  - *Continuous Learning*: Membuat/mengimprovisasi *skills* dari pengalaman, memiliki memori presisten (profil pengguna lintas sesi), FTS5 *session search*.
  - Multi-platform: TUI terminal, Telegram, Discord, Slack, dll (via *gateway*).

  - Subagents/Parallelism: Mendelegasikan tugas ke sub-agen terisolasi.

**2. hermes-agent-self-evolution**
- **Fungsi Utama**: Framework optimasi otomatis untuk `hermes-agent`.
- **Fitur Kunci**:
  - Evolusi *Skill* & *Prompt*: Menggunakan DSPy + GEPA untuk mengevaluasi *execution trace* dan memperbaiki *skills/prompts* secara otomatis (tanpa GPU training, via API LLM).

last_msg:
**Langkah 1: Buat Gateway di Cloudflare**
1. Login ke Dashboard Cloudflare.
2. Menu kiri → **AI** → **AI Gateway**.
3. Klik **Add New AI Gateway**.
4. Isi nama (misal: `saif-gateway`), klik **Create**.
5. Copy URL Endpoint. Formatnya:
`https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/{account_id}/saif-gateway`

**Langkah 2: Format URL Provider**
CF AI Gateway meneruskan request berdasarkan akhiran URL.
*   **OpenAI/Kimi/Deepseek (OpenAI Compatible):** `.../saif-gateway/openai`
*   **Anthropic:** `.../saif-gateway/anthropic`
*   **Groq:** `.../saif-gateway/groq`

**Langkah 3: Konfigurasi di Hermes Agent**
Ganti endpoint 9router dengan CF AI Gateway di config Hermes.

```bash
hermes config set model.base_url "https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/{account_id}/saif-gateway/openai"
hermes config set model.api_key "sk-api...uter"
```
*(Catatan: CF tidak butuh API Key sendiri untuk passthrough dasar, cukup API Key dari LLM asli).*

**Langkah 4: Aktifkan Fitur (Opsional tapi Wajib)**
Di Dashboard CF AI Gateway:
1. **Caching:** Aktifkan. Request berulang (prompt yang sama) di-serve dari cache CF (Rp 0, 0 ms).
2. **Logs:** Aktifkan untuk melihat metrik token & cost (menggantikan UI 9router).

**Langkah 5: Eksekusi Mati 9Router di VPS**
Bebaskan RAM/CPU VPS.
```bash
sudo systemctl stop 9router.service
sudo systemctl disable 9router.service
```

title: Identifikasi model LLM yang digunakan #3
last_msg:
Gue dapet gambaran penuhnya. Berikut analisis **tanpa bias** terhadap repository `alistaitsacle/free-llm-api-keys`:

---

### **1. Apa Project Ini Sebenarnya?**
Ini adalah repository yang membagikan **API Key gratis** secara publik (GPT-5.5, Claude, Gemini, dll) yang kompatibel dengan format OpenAI SDK. Kunci-kunci tersebut diperbarui otomatis beberapa kali sehari via bot GitHub Actions. Mereka juga menyediakan halaman web "Playground" gratis di GitHub Pages untuk mencoba kunci-kunci tersebut secara langsung.

---

### **2. Dari Mana Kunci/Model Tersebut Berasal?**
Kunci-kunci yang dibagikan memiliki format `sk-...` tetapi endpoint-nya **bukan langsung ke OpenAI/Anthropic**, melainkan diarahkan ke custom gateway/reverse proxy mereka sendiri di:
`https://aiapiv2.pekpik.com/v1`

Backend Key Manager mereka berada di `https://aiapiv2.pekpik.com/km`.

---

### **3. Analisis Keamanan & Potensi Risiko (Tanpa Bias)**

#### **A. Uptime & Keberlanjutan (Legitimacy)**
*   **Mengapa gratis?** Pembuat mengklaim membagi "sisa kapasitas produksi" (spare capacity) dari proyek mereka.
*   **Tujuan Komersial:** Di README tertulis: *"For production-grade LLM keys, contact alistaitscale@gmail.com"*. Ini adalah corong marketing (freemium funnel) untuk menjual API key / proxy API berbayar mereka ke developer yang butuh limit lebih tinggi.
*   **Daily Grant:** Program bagi-bagi harian di X (Twitter) digunakan untuk meningkatkan engagement akun media sosial mereka (`@getkeyway`).

#### **B. Risiko Kebocoran Data (Data Logging & Privacy)**
*   **Reverse Proxy / Man-In-The-Middle:** Karena semua request wajib dikirim ke domain mereka (`aiapiv2.pekpik.com`), mereka secara teknis bertindak sebagai perantara (proxy).
*   **Logging:** Pemilik proxy memiliki kemampuan teknis 100% untuk membaca, menyimpan, dan menganalisis semua teks/prompt/data sensitif yang dikirim melalui API key gratis tersebut.
*   **Playground Code:** Kode Javascript di halaman Playground (`docs/index.html`) berjalan murni di sisi klien (browser) menggunakan standar `fetch` langsung ke backend `/v1/chat/completions`. Tidak ada kode JS mencurigakan di frontend yang mengirim data ke server pihak ketiga lain di luar domain pekpik.com mereka. Namun, data chat tetap melewati server proxy pekpik.com.

#### **C. Potensi Token Harvesting (Pencurian Key User)**
*   Beberapa proyek "free key" palsu kadang dibuat untuk mencuri API key asli milik user yang mencoba memasukkannya ke kolom input.
*   Pada proyek ini, Playground web-nya meminta paste key. Namun, key yang di-paste disitu adalah key gratisan yang mereka berikan sendiri (bukan key pribadi user). Selama user tidak memasukkan API Key pribadi berbayar mereka ke sana, tidak ada risiko pencurian key.

---

### **4. Kesimpulan**
*   **Apakah ini scam/malicious?** Secara kode repositori, tidak ada malware atau pencurian data lokal. Ini adalah layanan **Reverse Proxy API** publik gratis dengan tujuan marketing (menjual API berbayar limit tinggi via email & naikin followers di X).
*   **Rekomendasi Penggunaan:**
    *   **AMAN** digunakan untuk: Eksperimen cepat, belajar, testing aplikasi non-sensitif, atau hobi.
    *   **TIDAK AMAN (Sangat Dilarang)** digunakan untuk: Aplikasi produksi, data perusahaan, data pengguna asli, atau pengiriman data sensitif (password, NIK, database rahasia), karena pemilik server proxy (`pekpik.com`) bisa membaca semua prompt Anda.

title: Hermes profile vs LLM
last_msg:
Cara aman per profile:

```bash
hermes -p default gateway restart
hermes -p fwp gateway restart
hermes -p prodig gateway restart
hermes -p raidxelon gateway restart
hermes -p saif gateway restart
```

Kalau mau loop:

```bash
for p in default fwp prodig raidxelon saif; do
  echo "restart $p"
  hermes -p "$p" gateway restart
done
```

Cek status:

```bash
hermes status --all
```

Atau:

```bash
hermes profile list
```

Kalau restart gagal karena service/lock:

```bash
hermes -p nama_profile gateway stop
hermes -p nama_profile gateway start
```

Untuk session CLI aktif ini, config baru biasanya perlu keluar lalu masuk lagi:

```bash
exit
hermes -p raidxelon
```

4. **Build DB models + migrations** — campaigns, adsets, creatives, customers, transactions, conversations
5. **Celery task definitions** — map each agent.run() ke Celery task
6. **Redis consumer loops** — agents harus listen ke stream masing-masing

Repo ini **architecture-nya solid** — lu udah bikin framework yang scalable. Tapi **semua agents masih "dummy"** — mereka punya struktur class, method signatures, dan Redis pub/sub, tapi isi method-nya return mock data.

title: Pemeriksaan README.md GitHub Obsidian
last_msg:
Repo status di VPS (raidxelon) sekarang **clean** — nggak ada unmerged changes. Semua commit dari MacBook sudah di-merge ke `main`:

| Commit | Dari | Isi |
|--------|------|-----|
| `6822113` | MacBook | `feat: unified memory sync system for multi-VPS Hermes` |
| `74486a9` | MacBook | `fix: auto-detect obsidian path for macOS` |

File baru yang dibuat:
- `06-SYSTEM/unified-memory-sync.sh` (338 baris)
- `06-SYSTEM/install-sync.sh` (137 baris)

Plus 1 untracked file: `03-RESOURCES/ai-memory/mac-default.md` — ini output dari MacBook sync.

---

## Tapi Ada Problem

### 1. **Script Over-Engineered**
`unified-memory-sync.sh` 338 baris untuk tugas yang sebenarnya simple: copy Markdown files dan git push. Hermes di MacBook bikin solusi yang terlalu kompleks:
- Auto-detect machine by hostname/IP
- Import logic dengan sed/awk parsing
- Backup mechanism
- Duplicate detection

Padahal Hermes memory format-nya cuma plain Markdown. Nggak perlu parsing segala.

### 2. **Cron Tiap 5 Menit = Overkill**
Bisa bikin GitHub rate limit atau conflict kalau 2 machine push bersamaan.

### 3. **Import Logic Berbahaya**
Line 172-224: `import_to_raidxelon()` nge-append memory dari profile lain ke raidxelon. Ini bisa bikin memory jadi duplikat dan berantakan.

### 4. **Duplikasi dengan Existing Workflow**
Gw di VPS (raidxelon) udah update README.md dan commit. Tapi Hermes di MacBook juga bikin changes. Untungnya nggak conflict.

---

## Rekomendasi: Simplifikasi

Script ini bisa di-replace dengan versi simple ~50 baris:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Simple memory sync: copy Hermes memory to Obsidian, git push
set -e

REPO="${HOME}/github/obsidian"
MEMORY_DIR="${REPO}/03-RESOURCES/ai-memory"
HOST=$(hostname -s)

cd "$REPO"
git pull --rebase origin main

# Export memory (simple copy)
for f in ~/.hermes/profiles/*/memories/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    profile=$(echo "$f" | sed 's|.*/profiles/\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|')
    cp "$f" "$MEMORY_DIR/${HOST}-${profile}-$(basename "$f")"
done

# Also copy default profile
for f in ~/.hermes/memories/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    cp "$f" "$MEMORY_DIR/${HOST}-default-$(basename "$f")"
done

# Push if changes
git add "$MEMORY_DIR"
git diff --cached --quiet || {
    git commit -m "ai-memory: sync from ${HOST} at $(date -Iseconds)"
    git push origin main
}
```

---

## Apa yang Perlu Dilakuin Sekarang

| Task | Priority | Action |
|------|----------|--------|
| 1. Review script complexity | Medium | Decide: keep atau simplify |
| 2. Fix cron interval | Medium | Ganti dari 5 menit ke hourly |
| 3. Hapus import logic | High | Jangan auto-merge memory, cuma copy |
| 4. Test sync | High | Jalanin manual, cek hasil |

---

1. **Simplifikasi script** jadi versi 50 baris?
2. **Fix cron** jadi hourly?
3. **Atau keep existing** dan coba jalanin dulu?

Atau lu mau handle sendiri di MacBook?

title: Ganti Model ke Kimi K2.7 Code
last_msg:
Oke, ini hasil analisis `auto-sync.yml`:

---

## Issues yang Ditemukan:

### 1. **Repo List Outdated**

Ada 34 repo di-list, tapi beberapa kemungkinan udah:
- Dihapus / renamed
- Dipindah ke org lain (e.g., `AmalProduktif`)
- Archived / inactive

Contoh yang perlu dicek:
- `wakaf-biz-id` — masih aktif?
- `ridloabelian-github-io` — mungkin renamed ke `ridloabelian.github.io`?

### 2. **Git Push Logic Risky**

```yaml
git push origin main || git push origin master
```

Ini bisa push ke branch salah kalau repo punya branch `main` tapi command pertama gagal karena alasan lain (bukan karena branch nggak ada). Harusnya detect branch dulu:
```bash
BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
git push origin "$BRANCH"
```

### 3. **Clone Semua Repo Setiap Run**

`--depth 1` membantu, tapi 34 repo tetep berat. Kalau ada repo private, clone bakal fail silently karena `2>/dev/null || true`.

**Fix:** 
- Skip repo yang udah archived
- Prioritize active repo only
- Consider GitHub API buat cek repo status dulu

### 4. **Scripts Path Hardcoded**

```yaml
python 99-META/scripts/generate-project-notes.py
python 99-META/scripts/generate-dashboard.py
```

Perlu verifikasi scripts ini exists & executable. Kalau script error, workflow tetep "success" karena nggak ada error handling.

### 5. **No Error Handling / Notification**

Kalau sync gagal (script error, push fail, dll), lu nggak bakal tahu kecuali cek Actions tab manual. Perlu:
- Slack/Telegram/Discord notification
- At least create issue kalau fail

### 6. **Cron Schedule — 06:00 UTC = 13:00 WIB**

Ini siang, bukan pagi. Kalau maksudnya "setiap pagi", harusnya `0 22 * * *` (05:00 WIB) atau `0 23 * * *` (06:00 WIB).

---

## Rekomendasi Fix:

| Issue | Priority | Action |
|-------|----------|--------|
| Repo list outdated | **High** | Audit 34 repo, hapus yang archived/deleted |
| Branch detection | **Medium** | Fix push logic |
| Error handling | **Medium** | Add notification / status check |
| Cron timezone | **Low** | Adjust ke 22:00 UTC untuk pagi WIB |
| Script validation | **Low** | Add `set -e` atau explicit error check |

**Run Date:** 2026-06-23 02:00 WIB  
**Status:** Analysis Complete — No new skills generated (existing 6 skills sufficient)

---

### 📊 Pattern Analysis Summary

| Skill | Source Uses | Key Insight |
|-------|------------|-------------|
| `learned-vps-node-deployment` | 10 | PORT=xxxx npm start mandatory |
| `learned-docker-compose-safety` | 20 | write_file corrupts YAML → use python3 |
| `learned-hermes-gateway-management` | 17 | Post-clone identity cleanup required |
| `learned-cloudflare-wrangler-automation` | 6 | Wrangler v4+ only reads env var |
| `learned-loop-corruption-prevention` | 16 | Never read corrupted file back |
| `learned-skill-authoring-workflow` | 8 | skill_manage writes to ~/.hermes/skills/ |

---

### 📈 Cron Job Activity Analysis (All Time)

| Agent | Runs | Status | Key Pattern |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| **vps-health-monitor** | 370 | ✅ 100% silent | All [SILENT] — system healthy |
| **auto-commit-agent** | 185 | ✅ 100% clean | No uncommitted changes ever found |
| **github-sync-agent** | 15 | ✅ All up-to-date | 0 commits pulled |
| **overnight-deploy-agent** | 4 | ✅ No triggers | No new commits, no deploys |
| **self-improving-agent** | 4 | ⚠️ 3/4 max_iterations | Agent hits 60-turn limit, loops |
| **meta-orchestrator-agent** | 13 | ⚠️ 2/13 max_iterations | Long outputs trigger false errors |

**Pattern counts from agent.log.1:**
- `silent_response`: 435 (watchdog pattern working)
- `repo_clean`: 185 (no code changes to commit)
- `max_iterations_reached`: 6 (self-improving + meta-orchestrator)
- `RuntimeError`: 39 (all vision provider misconfig, not agent failures)

---

### 🔍 Key Patterns Detected

**Pattern 1: Self-Improving Agent Hits Max Iterations (3/4 runs)**
- **Trigger:** Agent tries to scan all logs, read all files, generate skills
- **Problem:** 60-turn budget exhausted before completion
- **Root cause:** Over-ambitious analysis scope — tries to do too much

**Pattern 2: Meta-Orchestrator Agent Also Hits Max Iterations (2/13 runs)**
- **Trigger:** Complex multi-agent health checks
- **Problem:** Same 60-turn limit exhaustion
- **Root cause:** Too many tools called sequentially

**Pattern 3: API_SERVER_KEY Missing (ongoing since 2026-06-14)**
- **Trigger:** api_server platform configured without key
- **Impact:** No API server access, only cron jobs work
- **Status:** Gateway continues for cron execution only

---

### 📝 Log Evaluation

**What was attempted:**
- Scanned 36,728 lines of agent.log.1
- Checked 6 existing auto-generated skills
- Analyzed cron job execution patterns
- Identified max_iterations as primary failure mode

**What worked:**
- vps-health-monitor and auto-commit-agent are 100% reliable
- [SILENT] watchdog pattern prevents noise
- 6 existing skills cover all major workflows

**What to improve:**
1. **Self-improving agent prompt needs scope limit** — "Check last 7 days only" or "Focus on 1 pattern"
2. **Consider increasing max_iterations for analysis-heavy agents**
3. **Fix API_SERVER_KEY to restore full gateway functionality**

---

### 🎯 Decision: No New Skills Generated

**Reason:** Existing 6 skills already cover all detected patterns. The only new pattern is "max_iterations exhaustion" which is a **runtime configuration issue**, not a workflow pattern worth skillifying.

**Recommendation:** 
- Update self-improving-agent prompt to limit analysis scope
- Or increase `HERMES_MAX_ITERATIONS` for this specific cron job

---

**Generated 0 skills, learned 3 patterns (max_iterations exhaustion, API_SERVER_KEY missing, stable watchdog agents)**

last_msg:
## EVALUASI: Repo Obsidian Existing vs Ide Baru

### APA YANG SUDAH RIDLO PUNYA (Dan Bagus)

Repo `ridloabelian/obsidian` ini **sudah 70% jalan**. Bukan mulai dari nol.

**Yang sudah berfungsi:**

| Komponen | Status | Komentar |
|----------|--------|----------|
| PARA folder structure | ✅ | 00-INBOX sampai 99-META, proper |
| Project notes (36) | ✅ | Auto-generated dari git, frontmatter consistent |
| MAP-PROJECTS.md | ✅ | Dashboard dengan Dataview queries |
| AI Memory sync | ✅ | `03-RESOURCES/ai-memory/` dengan INDEX |
| GitHub Actions sync | ✅ | Daily cron, 36 repo di-clone |
| Agent conventions | ✅ | `AGENTS.md`, `conventions.md` |
| Session summaries | ✅ | `session-summaries/YYYY-MM-DD.md` |

**Ini bukan repo kosong. Ini sudah sistem.**

---

### APA YANG KURANG (Gap vs Artikel)

| Dari Artikel | Di Repo Ridlo | Gap |
|--------------|---------------|-----|
| `04 - HERMES-OUTPUTS/` | Tidak ada | Agent outputs gak tersimpan human-readable |
| `CLAUDE.md` di root | Tidak ada | System prompt living gak ada |
| 7 skills (morning brief, inbox processor, dll) | Hanya auto-sync | Agent gak "reason" atas vault |
| Filesystem MCP integration | Tidak ada | Hermes gak bisa baca/write vault real-time |
| Daily/weekly automated synthesis | Tidak ada | Cuma sync, gak ada intelligence layer |
| `06 - SYSTEM/skills/` | `AGENTS.md` saja | Skills gak terstruktur |

---

### VERDIK: ELABORASI, BUKAN MULAI DARI NOL

**Alasan elaborasi lebih baik:**

1. **36 project notes sudah ada** — mulai dari nol = buang kerja
2. **GitHub Actions sudah running** — infrastructure ada
3. **AI memory sync sudah jalan** — foundation knowledge layer ada
4. **Frontmatter sudah consistent** — `status`, `progress`, `priority`, `tech-stack`
5. **Dataview queries sudah ada** — dashboard berfungsi

**Yang perlu ditambah:**

```
obsidian/
├── 00-INBOX/                    # ✅ sudah ada
├── 01-PROJECTS/                 # ✅ sudah ada
├── 02-AREAS/                    # ✅ sudah ada
├── 03-RESOURCES/                # ✅ sudah ada (perlu expand)
│   └── ai-memory/               # ✅ sudah ada
├── 04-ARCHIVE/                  # ✅ sudah ada
├── 05-TEMPLATES/                # ✅ sudah ada
├── 06-SYSTEM/                   # ❌ BARU — pindah dari 99-META
│   ├── CLAUDE.md                # ❌ BARU — living system prompt
│   ├── skills/                  # ❌ BARU — 7 skills dari artikel
│   └── cronjobs/                # ❌ BARU — schedule definitions
├── 07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/           # ❌ BARU — agent outputs human-readable
│   ├── briefings/
│   ├── analyses/
│   ├── syntheses/
│   └── reviews/
├── 99-META/                     # ✅ sudah ada (scripts, dll)
└── README.md                    # ✅ sudah ada (update)
```

---

### PERUBAHAN MINIMAL YANG MAKSIMAL IMPACT

#### 1. Tambah `CLAUDE.md` di Root

Ini **living system prompt** yang dibaca agent setiap eksekusi.

```markdown
# CLAUDE.md — Otak Kedua Ridlo Abelian

## Vault Location
Repo: github.com/ridloabelian/obsidian
Local: /home/ridlo/github/obsidian

## Who I Am
Name: Ridlo Abelian
Role: Solopreneur, Muslim, AI-first
Target: Rp 1 Triliun by Q1 2030
Organization: Amal Produktif (admin@amalproduktif.com)

## Active Projects (High Priority)
1. [[plr-biz-id]]: 70% — React 19, Cloudflare. Next: production deploy
2. [[fwp-or-id]]: ?% — React 19, Vite 8, Cloudflare Pages. Next: content
3. [[saif-co-id]]: ?% — 47 agents, Cloudflare-native. Next: agent deployment

## Current Priorities
1. Deploy PLR.biz.id ke production
2. Content untuk FWP.or.id
3. Scale SAIF agents

## Topics I Think About Most
- Wakaf & Nazhir (LSP BWI certification SS.001-SS.010)
- AI-first SaaS architecture
- Cloudflare Workers / Edge computing
- Multi-agent orchestration
- Halal business models

## Writing Voice
- Indonesian + English technical terms
- Concise, no fluff, action-oriented
- "Gas" = execute immediately
- Muslim solopreneur mindset

## Output Instructions
- Reference specific project notes by path
- Save outputs to 07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/
- Date-stamp: YYYY-MM-DD-[type]-[topic].md
- Frontmatter with type and date

## Memory Instructions
Before execution: Read CLAUDE.md + relevant project notes
After execution: Store summary in memory + update vault note
```

#### 2. Tambah `07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/`

Setiap agent output disimpan sebagai Markdown.

```
07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/
├── briefings/           # Morning brief, daily summaries
├── analyses/            # Research, thinking partner sessions
├── syntheses/           # Weekly synthesis, project health
└── reviews/             # Project health, weekly reviews
```

#### 3. Pindah `99-META/scripts/` → `06-SYSTEM/`

Terus tambah `skills/` folder dengan 7 skills dari artikel.

#### 4. Update `README.md`

Tambah section:
- Hermes Outputs (link ke 07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/)
- Skills (link ke 06-SYSTEM/skills/)
- CLAUDE.md (link ke living system prompt)

---

### SKILLS YANG PRIORITAS TINGGI

Dari 7 skills artikel, ini yang paling masuk akal untuk Ridlo sekarang:

| Priority | Skill | Why |
|----------|-------|-----|
| 1 | **Project Health Monitor** | 36 project, banyak yang "unknown" status. Butuh assessment otomatis. |
| 2 | **Weekly Synthesis** | MAP-WEEKLY.md sudah ada tapi manual. Bisa auto-generate. |
| 3 | **Inbox Processor** | 00-INBOX ada tapi gak ada proses otomatis. |
| 4 | **Vault-Aware Morning Brief** | Bisa baca project status + generate briefing. |
| 5 | **Thinking Partner** | Manual trigger, low priority. |

---

### TEKNIS: Filesystem MCP

Untuk Hermes bisa baca/write vault real-time:

```bash
npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
```

Configure di Hermes:
```yaml
mcp_servers:
  filesystem:
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "/home/ridlo/github/obsidian"]
```

---

### REKOMENDASI AKSI

**Option A: Minimalist (1-2 jam)**
1. Buat `CLAUDE.md` di root
2. Buat `07-HERMES-OUTPUTS/` folder
3. Update `README.md`
4. Commit + push

**Option B: Full Elaboration (1 hari)**
1. Semua di Option A
2. Pindah struktur `99-META` → `06-SYSTEM`
3. Buat 5 skills (project health, weekly synthesis, inbox processor, morning brief, thinking partner)
4. Setup Filesystem MCP
5. Update GitHub Actions untuk generate lebih dari sekadar sync

**Option C: Hybrid (yang saya rekomendasikan)**
1. Option A sekarang (quick win)
2. Option B bertahap (satu skill per minggu)

---

### SATU HAL LAGI: `MAP-PROJECTS.md` Butuh Update

36 project, tapi banyak yang:
- `status: unknown` (14 project!)
- `progress: ?%`
- `next-action: ""` (kosong)

Ini **data quality problem**. Project Health Monitor skill bisa fix ini otomatis.

last_msg:
Oke, sekarang gw paham setup-nya:

## 🔍 Status 9Router

| Komponen | Detail |
|----------|--------|
| **Service** | `9router.service` (systemd) |
| **Port** | `20128` (localhost only) |
| **Reverse Proxy** | Nginx (port 443 → `9router.ridlo.id`) |
| **Base URL** | `http://localhost:20128` |

---

## 🎯 Masalah OAuth

Redirect ke `http://localhost:443/callback` — tapi 9router di port **20128**, bukan 443!

---

## ✅ Solusi Opsi 3: Manual Code Exchange

### Step 1: Ambil Authorization Code dari URL

Dari URL redirect di browser lu:
```
http://localhost:443/callback?...&code=4/0AdkVLPxDp7z9i6EQwoMrBbK-7OVxFg47nurT4h9Jwv2u1AavOD25q20OzJtyFI55GLNtcA&...
```

**Copy value `code=`** (yang setelah `code=` dan sebelum `&`):
```
4/0AdkVLPxDp7z9i6EQwoMrBbK-7OVxFg47nurT4h9Jwv2u1AavOD25q20OzJtyFI55GLNtcA
```

---

### Step 2: Exchange Code untuk Access Token

Dari VPS, run:

```bash
curl -X POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "code=4/0AdkVLPxDp7z9i6EQwoMrBbK-7OVxFg47nurT4h9Jwv2u1AavOD25q20OzJtyFI55GLNtcA" \
  -d "client_id=1071006060591-tmhssin2h21lcre235vtolojh4g403ep.apps.googleusercontent.com" \
  -d "client_secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d "redirect_uri=http://localhost:443/callback" \
  -d "grant_type=authorization_code"
```

**⚠️ Butuh `client_secret`!** Cek di:
- `/home/ridlo/9router/.env` atau
- Google Cloud Console → Credentials

---

### Step 3: Kirim Token ke 9Router

Setelah dapet `access_token` dan `refresh_token`, kirim ke 9Router API:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:20128/api/auth/google/callback \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "access_token": "***",
    "refresh_token": "***",
    "scope": "email profile https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform ..."
  }'
```

---

## ❓ Pertanyaan

1. **Ada client_secret di .env?** Gw lihat env tapi secret-nya redacted (`***`)
2. **Atau mau gw cek API endpoint 9Router** — ada endpoint khusus untuk manual OAuth?

Mau gw cek dulu endpoint API yang tersedia? Atau lu punya client_secret dari Google Cloud Console? 🚀

- **Session dumps are error logs, not task logs**: `request_dump_*.json` files only contain failures (429 rate limit, 404 resource not found) — no actual task content

- **Skills are concise but shallow**: 50-line limit means deep context (like full nginx configs) is referenced, not included

title: SSH Connection Failure via Cloudflare DNS
last_msg:
Betul bro, **justru lebih aman sekarang** 🛡️

**Keuntungan setup sekarang:**

1. **IP asli VPS tersembunyi** — attacker nggak bisa direct scan/port knock ke IP Tencent kamu
2. **DDoS protection Cloudflare** — layer 3/4 attack ke domain kamu diabsorb Cloudflare edge
3. **SSH brute force jadi useless** — kalau coba `ssh vps.ridlo.id` malah nyasar ke Cloudflare, bukan ke VPS
4. **Tailscale jadi "backdoor" aman** — access internal via WireGuard mesh, tanpa expose port SSH ke publik sama sekali

**Trade-off:**
- SSH via domain publik gagal (by design, karena Cloudflare proxy)
- Harus pakai IP langsung atau Tailscale untuk remote

---

**Rekomendasi hardening tambahan (opsional tapi recommended):**

| Layer | Action |
|-------|--------|
| SSH | Disable password auth, pakai key-only (`PubkeyAuthentication yes`, `PasswordAuthentication no`) |
| SSH | Ganti port dari 22 ke non-standard (e.g. 2222, 7022) |
| SSH | `AllowUsers ridlo` — whitelist user saja |
| Fail2ban | Aktifkan untuk SSH + nginx |
| Tailscale | Enable ACL tags, disable key expiry untuk VPS |

---
